en: Sepia-toned panoramic view over a small European town from a slightly elevated vantage point. In the foreground there is a wooden fence and dense trees and gardens. Behind them stand low industrial or warehouse-type buildings with many identical windows. Further up the hillside are rows of residential houses with steep roofs, and among the trees in the distance a church tower with a dome or onion-shaped spire rises above the town. A wooded hill forms the backdrop. The print has white borders with slightly scalloped edges, typical of early–mid 20th‑century postcards. No visible text appears on the image side.
